src='''def transform(grid):
    # Copy each non-background pattern from a sector into corresponding positions
    # in all sectors separated by full grid lines.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    divider_rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(v != bg for v in grid[r])]
    divider_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] != bg for r in range(h))]
    rb = [-1] + divider_rows + [h]
    cb = [-1] + divider_cols + [w]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Use the sector containing the greatest number of non-background, non-divider cells as source.
    sectors = []
    for ri in range(len(rb)-1):
        for ci in range(len(cb)-1):
            r0,r1=rb[ri]+1,rb[ri+1]
            c0,c1=cb[ci]+1,cb[ci+1]
            count=sum(grid[r][c] != bg for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1))
            sectors.append((count,r0,r1,c0,c1))
    _,sr0,sr1,sc0,sc1=max(sectors)
    for r in range(h):
        if any(r==x for x in divider_rows): continue
        rr=(r-sr0) % (sr1-sr0) + sr0
        for c in range(w):
            if c in divider_cols: continue
            cc=(c-sc0) % (sc1-sc0) + sc0
            if grid[rr][cc] != bg:
                out[r][c]=grid[rr][cc]
    return out
'''
